newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Eco-Systems sees Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Eco-Systems sees Q2 loss.

text.p: Consolidated Ece-Systems Inc, formerly Exsorbet Industries Inc, said on Friday it expects to report a $4.9 million loss for the second quarter on revenues of $7.5 million.
Consolidated said in a news release that it applied to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an extension that would delay its financial-results release until August 19.
The company said that $3.75 million of the loss would be due to non-cash, non-recurring items, and $450,000 in depreciation and amortization costs.

"We have elected to take write-downs for items we believe no longer provide benefit to the company and that will allow us to go forward with a clean slate," James Connors Jr, Consolidated's president and chief executive, said in the release.
Consolidated provides site remediation, coal and petroleum tar liquefication and recycling, hazardous waste/spill cleanup services, civil and environmental engineering and other related services.
